newsitem.title: USA: Elimination of Mass. counties probable - official.
newsitem.headline: Elimination of Mass. counties probable - official.

text.p: Massachusetts House Speaker Thomas Finneran told reporters at a statehouse news conference on Wednesday there are probably enough votes to eliminate Middlesex County government.

Asked whether or not there were enough votes in the House to wipe out government in Massachusetts' largest county, which serves as home to both Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Finneran replied, "Probably, there are.
"At this point, there's institutional frustration and an awareness that we have been the bail out of last resort for too long," the Boston Democrat said.
Middlesex County defaulted on about $4.5 million of revenue anticipation notes last month.
